analysis_support: intersection of point-in-time S&P 500 membership and valid quarterly embeddings
null_definition: 95th percentile of cosine similarity across deterministic random distinct firm pairs within the quarterly common-support universe
candidate_score: maximum over nominating seeds of cosine_similarity times positive_seed_score
direct_seed_exclusion: exclude all direct positive LLM seeds from embedding-only candidates
primary_candidate_cardinality: equal to positive LLM seeds within common embedding support
placebo_rule: draw equal-count pseudo-seeds from non-seed common-support firms and apply identical propagation and cardinality rules
